reason: Codex failures in queued theme jobs used to trigger paid-API fallback on every attempt, so a Sumopod budget exhaustion ($45 of $45) turned each 504 into a failed fallback and an LlmFailureNotifier alert. The change defers the paid fallback to the final attempt via job middleware and a static flag on LlmClient. No existing skill covers LLM provider fallback, so this is a new class-level skill. It supersedes the fixed 45s bound in .ai/rules/services.md for queued jobs, which stage_skill cannot edit.
